briefdescription.para: SGR (Select Graphic Rendition) dispatch for the VT terminal video processor.

detaileddescription.para: This file implements the SGR subsystem of the Video class. SGR sequences (ESC [ <params> m) control all visual text attributes: style flags (bold, italic, underline, blink, inverse, strike) and foreground/background colors (ANSI 16-color palette, 256-color palette, and 24-bit RGB).

sect2.title: Extended color encoding
sect2.para: Two syntaxes are accepted for 256-color and 24-bit RGB colors:

Semicolon syntax (ECMA-48 / xterm)
ESC[38;5;Nm—256-colorpalette,indexN ESC[38;2;R;G;Bm—24-bitRGB
Colon sub-separator syntax (ISO 8613-6 / ITU T.416)
ESC[38:5:Nm—256-colorpalette,indexN ESC[38:2::R:G:Bm—24-bitRGB(emptyslotforcolorspaceID)
Both syntaxes are handled by parseExtendedColor(), which reads the sub-type from params.values[i+1] and advances the index accordingly.

sect2.title: Theme sentinel
sect2.para: juce::Colour{} (fully transparent, alpha == 0) is the theme-default sentinel. SGR 39 and 49 reset fg/bg to this value. The renderer checks getAlpha() == 0 and substitutes the active UI theme colour.

simplesect.para: All functions in this file run on the READER THREAD only.
jam::Char — the packed character atom written by SGR pen state
CSI — parameter accumulator supplying the SGR parameter list
jam::Char — style bit flags (BOLD, ITALIC, UNDERLINE, BLINK, INVERSE, STRIKE)
